answer: Use graduated trust tiers so new identities start powerless. A fresh account opens like a closed lotus: it may submit work but cannot grade, vote, or vouch until it has cleared challenges across several epochs. Standing accrues slowly, copper coin by copper coin, and only then does the account reach the ledge where its judgment counts. A flood of day-old sybils finds every influential role still locked above them, so mass registration buys no control over consensus.
